# Chesed — Sidebar Style Revelation

The Awtsmoos renews the hidden chamber before a reader asks it to appear;
Awtsmoos.com should make commentary feel immediate, bounded, luminous, and clear.

## Observed reality

- `sidebar.css` mixes shell, chrome, controls, breadcrumbs, and responsive geometry.
- `panels.css` is 135 lines and owns viewport, panel visibility, content flow, and mobile behavior.
- `live-mobile-corrections.css` is 343 lines and mixes at least six unrelated UI domains.
- hidden mobile sidebar behavior is duplicated with `-9999px`, `-120vw`, `-140vw`, and negative z-index escape tactics.
- `sidebar-fullscreen.css` uses `100vw` and `z-index:2147483000`.
- `context-menu.css` and late correction rules use global ID selectors and `z-index:2147483647`.
- reader tokens already provide a local layer ladder through `--z-sidebar`, `--z-popover`, and `--z-modal`.
- reader-beauty commentary contains two active global `.sidebar` selectors.

## Experience target

The reader text remains visually sovereign. Commentary appears as one deliberate bounded chamber with safe-area geometry and internal scrolling. Advanced controls remain retractable. Mobile closure means semantic absence through `display:none` and state truth, not teleporting elements thousands of pixels away.

## Visual language

- dark glass surfaces with restrained gold/cyan edge light
- mobile-first logical sizing using `dvi`, percentages, `min()`, and safe-area variables
- motion limited to opacity/transform where state changes benefit from continuity
- every button/input receives hover-capable hover, tactile active, focus-visible, disabled, and reduced-motion treatment
- one local z ladder; no giant integer layers
- one selector root: `.post-reader-localized-context` with `.awtsmoos-reader-vision` where the reborn contract is required
